title: InstallManifest
description: EIIS v1.4 §1.8 install manifest schema. Written to <target>/install.manifest.json by install.sh. Records the installed files and their roles for conformance checking.

eiis_version.description: EIIS spec version this manifest conforms to.

install_ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the install run.

ecl_version.description: ECL version declared by this Eidolon (EIIS §3.7.1).

files_written.description: Inventory of files written to the install target. Used by EIIS conformance checker and cleanup_inventory_sweep.

path.description: Path relative to the install target root.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the written file. Required for ecl-version role (EIIS §3.7.1 verbatim-equal check).
